name: sam_search_opportunities
description: Search active federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov by keywords, NAICS code, set-aside type (small business, 8a, WOSB, HUBZone), agency, and state.

naics_code.description: NAICS industry code, e.g. "561720" for janitorial services

set_aside_code.description: Set-aside type: SBA (Small Business), 8A (8(a)), WOSB, EDWOSB, HZC (HUBZone), VOSB, SDVOSB

agency.description: Agency or department name, e.g. "Department of Defense"

state.description: Two-letter state code for place of performance, e.g. "CO"

posted_from.description: Posted on or after this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

posted_to.description: Posted on or before this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

name: sam_get_opportunity
description: Get full details for a specific federal contract opportunity by its SAM.gov notice ID. Includes description, contacts, and attachments.

name: sam_list_opportunity_attachments
description: Get all documents and attachments for a federal contract opportunity, including SOW, solicitation package, and Q&A documents.

name: sam_search_opportunities_by_naics
description: Search active federal contract opportunities filtered by a specific NAICS industry code. Best for finding all contracts in a particular trade or service category.

name: sam_search_opportunities_by_agency
description: Get all active contract opportunities posted by a specific federal agency or department.

agency.description: Agency name or code, e.g. "Department of Veterans Affairs"

name: sam_search_opportunities_near_location
description: Search for federal contract opportunities with a place of performance near a given ZIP code. Useful for finding local government contracts.

zip_code.description: ZIP code for place of performance

name: sam_search_awards
description: Search federal contract award history via USASpending.gov by keywords, NAICS code, agency, or contractor UEI. Returns award amounts and recipients.

uei.description: Contractor UEI number to filter by recipient

name: sam_get_award
description: Get full details for a specific federal contract award by award ID from USASpending.gov. Includes amounts, timeline, and contractor details.

name: sam_list_awards_by_contractor
description: Get all federal contract awards received by a specific contractor, identified by their UEI (Unique Entity Identifier). Shows award history and total amounts.

name: sam_list_awards_by_agency
description: Get all federal contract awards issued by a specific agency. Useful for researching what a department is spending on and who is winning their contracts.

name: sam_search_entities
description: Search the SAM.gov entity registry for registered contractors and vendors. Filter by company name, state, or NAICS code.

name: sam_get_entity
description: Get full SAM.gov entity registration for a specific contractor by their UEI. Returns CAGE code, address, business type, and NAICS codes.

name: sam_check_entity_active
description: Verify whether a contractor is currently active and eligible for federal contracts on SAM.gov. Returns registration status and expiration date.

name: sam_check_exclusions
description: Check whether a company or individual is excluded (debarred) from receiving federal contracts. Returns exclusion type, agency, and dates.

name.description: Company or individual name to check

uei.description: UEI to check (more precise than name)

name: sam_search_wage_determinations
description: Search Service Contract Act and Davis-Bacon Act wage determinations by state, county, or keywords. Required for government service contracts.

type.description: WD type: SCA (Service Contract Act) or DBA (Davis-Bacon Act)

name: sam_get_wage_determination
description: Get the current wage rates for a specific wage determination number and revision. Returns minimum pay rates by job classification.

revision.description: Revision number (optional, returns latest if omitted)

name: sam_list_naics_codes
description: Search NAICS (North American Industry Classification System) codes by keyword to find the right industry code for a contracting service.

name: sam_get_naics_code
description: Get full description and details for a specific NAICS code including sector, subsector, industry group, and size standard.

name: sam_find_opportunities_for_contractor
description: SUPER TOOL: Find federal contract opportunities that match a contractor's profile. Searches across multiple NAICS codes and filters by state. Returns ranked, summarized opportunities ready for bidding.

naics_codes.description: Array of NAICS codes the contractor works in (up to 3 searched)

state.description: State code to filter by place of performance

name: sam_contractor_due_diligence
description: SUPER TOOL: Full contractor vetting in one call — entity registration status + exclusions check. Verifies if a company is SAM-registered, active, and not debarred. Essential before partnering or subcontracting.

name: sam_bid_opportunity_summary
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a complete bid package summary for a contract opportunity — full description, response deadline, agency contact, NAICS code, set-aside type, and all attachments in one structured call.
